title: Number health
intro: Whether callers may see a spam warning on your numbers, and how carriers sign your outbound calls.
noProvider: No reputation provider is connected yet, so nothing has been checked and statuses show “Not checked”. Use the steps under each number in the meantime.
checkRecent: Checked a moment ago. Try again in a few minutes.
checkFailed: Could not check right now. Try again later.

attestation.label: Call signing (STIR/SHAKEN)
attestation.A: A – full: the carrier vouches for you and the number
attestation.B: B – partial: the carrier knows you but cannot vouch for the number
attestation.C: C – gateway: the carrier only passed the call on

stale: This result is more than a day and a half old. Treat it as out of date.
lastError: The last attempt failed; showing the last successful result.

remediation.title: What to do
remediation.saveFailed: Could not save that tick. Try again.

pause_outbound.title: Pause high-volume outbound calling from this number
pause_outbound.detail: Until the label clears, use another registered number for bulk or campaign calls.

check_registration.title: Check your caller-ID and registration
check_registration.detail: Make sure your business name, caller-ID name and any SMS or toll-free registration match everywhere. The registration checklist is further down this page.

review_call_patterns.title: Review recent calling patterns
review_call_patterns.detail: Carriers commonly pay attention to very short calls, high call volume and many unanswered calls. Look for anything unusual from this number.

ask_relabel.title: Ask for the label to be reviewed
ask_relabel.detail: Your carrier can tell you which analytics services label your calls and how each one takes review requests. The process differs by service.

contact_carrier.title: Open a ticket with your carrier
contact_carrier.detail: Give them the number, the label you see and the date. Keep the ticket reference.

verify_attestation.title: Ask why calls are not fully signed (A)
verify_attestation.detail: Ask your carrier what they need to confirm you own this number and your business.

register_cnam.title: Register your caller-ID name
register_cnam.detail: Use the Caller-ID name section below. Display is not guaranteed on every network.

connect_provider.title: Connect a reputation provider
connect_provider.detail: Until one is connected, Vireek cannot read spam labels or call signing for your numbers.

manual_check.title: Check by calling from this number
manual_check.detail: Call a phone on a different carrier and note what the screen shows. This is a manual spot check, not a measurement.

keep_monitoring.title: Keep monitoring
keep_monitoring.detail: Nothing to fix now. Vireek re-checks on a schedule.
